units.source_text: 这个时候周围的教众，看着罗连一往无前的英雄身姿，也都顿时忘了他被破门的耻辱，

en.t: At that moment, the believers around him saw Luo Lian's fearless, heroic figure and at once forgot the shame of his excommunication.

units.source_text: 呼声雷动，交口议论：“父子亲情本是天性，终究是不能抹杀的。

en.t: A roar of voices rose like thunder, and people said to one another, "The bond between father and child is human nature itself; in the end it cannot be erased.

units.source_text: 因为愧疚很久不出现的罗连，最后还是为了拯救自己的骨肉，舍身进入火海了。”

en.t: Luo Lian, who had stayed away for so long out of shame, still threw himself into the sea of fire at last to save his own flesh and blood."

units.source_text: 伞翁也有同样的感受，看着罗连消失的身影，不在沉默不语，也大喊出声。

en.t: The old umbrella man felt the same way; watching Luo Lian's figure disappear, he too could no longer keep silent and shouted aloud.

units.source_text: 伞女则跪在低上，双手捂着脸，一心祈祷，动也不动。

en.t: The umbrella girl knelt on the ground, covered her face with both hands, and prayed with all her heart without moving at all.

units.source_text: 空中火舌飞舞，浓烟滚滚，扑面而来。

en.t: Tongues of flame danced in the air, while thick smoke billowed and rushed against their faces.

units.source_text: 伞女只是低头默默祈祷，好像不知道周围发生的任何事情。

en.t: The umbrella girl only bowed her head and prayed silently, as though she knew nothing of anything happening around her.
